title: RK4 Damped Harmonic Oscillator
description: Fourth-order Runge-Kutta (RK4) numerical integrator in Fortran 90 solving a viscously damped mechanical mass-spring-damper oscillator with energy tracking.
code:
subroutine damped_oscillator_rk4(x_in, v_in, x_out, v_out, energy)
  implicit none
  real(8) :: x_in, v_in, x_out, v_out, energy
  real(8) :: m, c, k, dt, inv_m
  real(8) :: k1x, k1v, k2x, k2v, k3x, k3v, k4x, k4v
  real(8) :: xm2, vm2, xm3, vm3, xm4, vm4

  m = 2.0d0
  c = 0.4d0
  k = 18.0d0
  dt = 0.01d0
  inv_m = 0.5d0

  k1x = v_in
  k1v = -(c * v_in + k * x_in) * inv_m

  xm2 = x_in + 0.5d0 * dt * k1x
  vm2 = v_in + 0.5d0 * dt * k1v
  k2x = vm2
  k2v = -(c * vm2 + k * xm2) * inv_m

  xm3 = x_in + 0.5d0 * dt * k2x
  vm3 = v_in + 0.5d0 * dt * k2v
  k3x = vm3
  k3v = -(c * vm3 + k * xm3) * inv_m

  xm4 = x_in + dt * k3x
  vm4 = v_in + dt * k3v
  k4x = vm4
  k4v = -(c * vm4 + k * xm4) * inv_m

  x_out = x_in + (dt * 0.1666666666666667d0) * (k1x + 2.0d0 * k2x + 2.0d0 * k3x + k4x)
  v_out = v_in + (dt * 0.1666666666666667d0) * (k1v + 2.0d0 * k2v + 2.0d0 * k3v + k4v)
  energy = 0.5d0 * m * v_out * v_out + 0.5d0 * k * x_out * x_out
end subroutine damped_oscillator_rk4

title: 1D Explicit Heat Conduction Equation Solver
description: Finite-difference FTCS explicit parabolic PDE solver for one-dimensional transient heat diffusion along an aluminum rod with fixed Dirichlet boundaries.
code:
subroutine heat1d_step(t_mid)
  implicit none
  real(8) :: t_mid
  real(8) :: u(41), u_new(41)
  real(8) :: r
  integer :: i, n

  r = 0.25d0

  do i = 1, 41
    u(i) = 20.0d0
    u_new(i) = 20.0d0
  end do
  u(1) = 100.0d0
  u(41) = 20.0d0

  do n = 1, 200
    u_new(1) = 100.0d0
    u_new(41) = 20.0d0
    do i = 2, 40
      u_new(i) = u(i) + r * (u(i + 1) - 2.0d0 * u(i) + u(i - 1))
    end do
    do i = 1, 41
      u(i) = u_new(i)
    end do
  end do

  t_mid = u(21)
end subroutine heat1d_step

title: Symmetric Positive-Definite Conjugate Gradient Solver
description: Matrix-free Krylov subspace Conjugate Gradient solver for a 1D discrete Poisson tridiagonal linear system with residual norm convergence check.
code:
subroutine cg_tridiagonal_solve(res_norm)
  implicit none
  real(8) :: res_norm
  real(8) :: x(16), b(16), r(16), p(16), ap(16)
  real(8) :: rsold, rsnew, pap, alpha, beta, denom_pap, denom_rs
  integer :: i, iter

  do i = 1, 16
    x(i) = 0.0d0
    b(i) = 1.0d0
    r(i) = 1.0d0
    p(i) = 1.0d0
    ap(i) = 0.0d0
  end do

  rsold = 16.0d0

  do iter = 1, 30
    ap(1) = 2.0d0 * p(1) - p(2)
    do i = 2, 15
      ap(i) = -p(i - 1) + 2.0d0 * p(i) - p(i + 1)
    end do
    ap(16) = -p(15) + 2.0d0 * p(16)

    pap = 0.0d0
    do i = 1, 16
      pap = pap + p(i) * ap(i)
    end do

    denom_pap = 1.0d0
    if (pap > 1.0d-12) then
      denom_pap = pap
    end if
    alpha = rsold / denom_pap

    rsnew = 0.0d0
    do i = 1, 16
      x(i) = x(i) + alpha * p(i)
      r(i) = r(i) - alpha * ap(i)
      rsnew = rsnew + r(i) * r(i)
    end do

    denom_rs = 1.0d0
    if (rsold > 1.0d-12) then
      denom_rs = rsold
    end if
    beta = rsnew / denom_rs

    do i = 1, 16
      p(i) = r(i) + beta * p(i)
    end do
    rsold = rsnew
  end do

  res_norm = rsold
end subroutine cg_tridiagonal_solve

title: Modular Orbital Two-Body Keplerian Propagator
description: Multi-module Fortran 90 astrodynamics propagator integrating a Low-Earth-Orbit satellite state vector via shared physical constants and an RK4 integrator module.
code:
program orbital_propagator
  use constants_mod
  use rk4_mod
  implicit none

  real(8) :: state(6), dt, t, r_orbit, v_circ
  integer :: step

  r_orbit = 6.778137d6
  v_circ = 7668.55d0
  state(1) = r_orbit
  state(2) = 0.0d0
  state(3) = 0.0d0
  state(4) = 0.0d0
  state(5) = v_circ
  state(6) = 0.0d0

  dt = 10.0d0
  t = 0.0d0

  do step = 1, 540
    call rk4_orbit_step(state, dt)
    t = t + dt
  end do
end program orbital_propagator

module constants_mod
  implicit none
  real(8), parameter :: MU_EARTH = 3.986004418d14
  real(8), parameter :: R_EARTH  = 6.378137d6
end module constants_mod
files.rk4_mod.f90:
module rk4_mod
  use constants_mod
  implicit none
contains
  subroutine two_body_rhs(y, dydt)
    real(8), intent(in)  :: y(6)
    real(8), intent(out) :: dydt(6)
    real(8) :: r, r3

    r = sqrt(y(1)*y(1) + y(2)*y(2) + y(3)*y(3))
    r3 = max(r * r * r, 1.0d-12)
    dydt(1) = y(4)
    dydt(2) = y(5)
    dydt(3) = y(6)
    dydt(4) = -MU_EARTH * y(1) / r3
    dydt(5) = -MU_EARTH * y(2) / r3
    dydt(6) = -MU_EARTH * y(3) / r3
  end subroutine two_body_rhs

  subroutine rk4_orbit_step(y, dt)
    real(8), intent(inout) :: y(6)
    real(8), intent(in)    :: dt
    real(8) :: k1(6), k2(6), k3(6), k4(6)

    call two_body_rhs(y, k1)
    call two_body_rhs(y + 0.5d0 * dt * k1, k2)
    call two_body_rhs(y + 0.5d0 * dt * k2, k3)
    call two_body_rhs(y + dt * k3, k4)
    y = y + (dt / 6.0d0) * (k1 + 2.0d0 * k2 + 2.0d0 * k3 + k4)
  end subroutine rk4_orbit_step
end module rk4_mod

title: 2D Lid-Driven Cavity Navier-Stokes Projection Solver
description: Multi-module Fortran 90 incompressible CFD fractional-step projection solver separating Cartesian grid parameters, pressure Poisson relaxation, and wall boundary conditions.
code:
program cavity_navier_stokes
  use grid_mod
  use poisson_mod
  use bc_mod
  implicit none

  real(8) :: u(289), v(289), p(289), rhs(289)
  real(8) :: dt, nu, inv_2dx, inv_dx2, inv_dt, u_center
  integer :: step, k

  dt = 0.002d0
  nu = 0.01d0
  inv_2dx = 8.0d0
  inv_dx2 = 256.0d0
  inv_dt = 500.0d0

  do k = 1, 289
    u(k) = 0.0d0
    v(k) = 0.0d0
    p(k) = 0.0d0
    rhs(k) = 0.0d0
  end do

  do step = 1, 20
    call apply_cavity_bc(u, v)
    do k = 19, 271
      rhs(k) = ((u(k + 1) - u(k - 1)) * inv_2dx + (v(k + 17) - v(k - 17)) * inv_2dx) * inv_dt
    end do
    call solve_pressure_poisson(p, rhs, 15)
    do k = 19, 271
      u(k) = u(k) - dt * (p(k + 1) - p(k - 1)) * inv_2dx + nu * dt * (u(k + 1) - 2.0d0 * u(k) + u(k - 1)) * inv_dx2
      v(k) = v(k) - dt * (p(k + 17) - p(k - 17)) * inv_2dx + nu * dt * (v(k + 17) - 2.0d0 * v(k) + v(k - 17)) * inv_dx2
    end do
  end do

  u_center = u(145)
end program cavity_navier_stokes

files.grid_mod.f90:
module grid_mod
  implicit none
  integer, parameter :: NX = 17
  integer, parameter :: NY = 17
  real(8), parameter :: DX = 1.0d0 / dble(NX - 1)
  real(8), parameter :: DY = 1.0d0 / dble(NY - 1)
end module grid_mod
files.poisson_mod.f90:
module poisson_mod
  use grid_mod
  implicit none
contains
  subroutine solve_pressure_poisson(p, rhs, nit)
    real(8), intent(inout) :: p(NX, NY)
    real(8), intent(in)    :: rhs(NX, NY)
    integer, intent(in)    :: nit
    real(8) :: pn(NX, NY), denom
    integer :: it, i, j

    denom = 2.0d0 * (DX * DX + DY * DY)
    do it = 1, nit
      pn = p
      do j = 2, NY - 1
        do i = 2, NX - 1
          p(i, j) = ((pn(i + 1, j) + pn(i - 1, j)) * DY * DY + &
                     (pn(i, j + 1) + pn(i, j - 1)) * DX * DX - &
                     rhs(i, j) * DX * DX * DY * DY) / denom
        end do
      end do
      p(1, :) = p(2, :)
      p(NX, :) = p(NX - 1, :)
      p(:, 1) = p(:, 2)
      p(:, NY) = 0.0d0
    end do
  end subroutine solve_pressure_poisson
end module poisson_mod
files.bc_mod.f90:
module bc_mod
  use grid_mod
  implicit none
contains
  subroutine apply_cavity_bc(u, v)
    real(8), intent(inout) :: u(NX, NY), v(NX, NY)
    u(1, :) = 0.0d0
    u(NX, :) = 0.0d0
    u(:, 1) = 0.0d0
    u(:, NY) = 1.0d0
    v(1, :) = 0.0d0
    v(NX, :) = 0.0d0
    v(:, 1) = 0.0d0
    v(:, NY) = 0.0d0
  end subroutine apply_cavity_bc
end module bc_mod
